verdict.rationale: Snyk's official CLI is documented to run in CI/CD pipelines as well as locally. It provides scriptable commands for open-source, code and secrets scanning (`snyk test`, `snyk code test`, `snyk secrets test`). Snyk also ships dedicated Organization-level role templates so service accounts in CI/CD pipelines can run CLI commands, plus build-time reporting via the snyk-to-html plugin. One community comment calls the integration across hundreds of builds 'challenging', but that is a complaint about value, not evidence that headless use fails. missing for 10: documented non-interactive auth/token setup, machine-readable output and exit-code behavior for pipeline gating, concrete CI-platform integration guides, positive independent hands-on corroboration.
